name: Douyin Video Interaction
description: Interact with a specific Douyin video by modal_id: like, comment, reply, download. Uses AppleScript + Chrome JS + cliclick.
usage:
PYTHONPATH=~/.clawbie/toolkits/douyin-video python3 -c "
from douyin_video.tools import <func>
print(<func>(...))
"

Available functions:
- open_video(modal_id) — open video detail modal by ID
- download_video(save_path) — download the playing video to local file
- like_video() — toggle like on current video
- open_comments() — open comment panel for current video
- get_comments() — read comments from the open panel
- post_comment(text) — post a comment
- reply_comment(comment_index, text) — reply to a specific comment
- close_comments() — close the comment panel
- close_video() — close the video modal
- wait() — random 3-5s delay for anti-bot
install: Requires macOS + Google Chrome + cliclick (brew install cliclick). Accessibility permission required.
